description: This file implements a CSI translator for Portworx volumes in Kubernetes, including functions for translating storage classes, inline volumes, and persistent volumes between in-tree and CSI formats.

classes.name: portworxCSITranslator
classes.description: Implements the InTreePlugin interface for Portworx CSI translation.

methods.name: NewPortworxCSITranslator
methods.description: Creates a new instance of portworxCSITranslator.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeStorageClassToCSI
methods.description: Translates an in-tree StorageClass to a CSI-compatible StorageClass for Portworx.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeInlineVolumeToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree Portworx volume to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateInTreePVToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree Portworx PersistentVolume to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateCSIPVToInTree
methods.description: Converts a CSI PersistentVolume back to an in-tree Portworx volume.

methods.name: CanSupport
methods.description: Checks if a PersistentVolume is supported by Portworx CSI.

methods.name: CanSupportInline
methods.description: Checks if an inline volume is supported by Portworx CSI.

methods.name: GetInTreePluginName
methods.description: Returns the in-tree plugin name for Portworx.

methods.name: GetCSIPluginName
methods.description: Returns the CSI plugin name for Portworx.

methods.name: RepairVolumeHandle
methods.description: Repairs or generates a correct volume handle based on node ID.
